_readme: Edit this file to change the notification switches and copy. It is re-read on every trigger, so no reinstall and no app restart is needed. Strict JSON only: no comments, no trailing commas. Placeholders: {subject} = project/session name, {detail} = question, approval reason, or error message.

settings._mode: 'always' notifies on every trigger; 'off' disables the plugin.
settings._sound: 'none' keeps it silent; 'ding' plays C:\Windows\Media\ding.wav; 'system' plays your Windows sound scheme.
settings._aumid: Toast identity. Windows shows this app name above the notification text.
settings._locale: 'zh' or 'en'; picks the message set below.
settings._debug: debugLog appends every decision to %TEMP%\dsh-desktop-notifications.log; debugEvents also logs every received trigger event.
settings._announceOnStart: true fires one notification while the plugin activates — handy as a smoke test.
